body_html:
It is rare to see such an amazing group of people come together to make one night in a couples life the most amazing of their lives. That is just what transpired at Hudson Gardens in Littleton tonight. Lisa and Mark brought all of their friends and family together for a wonderful wedding. Thanks to everyone who made their special day that much better.

 

DJ Bryan
